Smith & Locke 8-piece bungee cord set provides dependable, flexible load restraint for trade, transport and site use. Designed for securing cargo on motorcycles, trailers, trucks and boats. The set includes multiple lengths of 8mm cords (2 x 40cm, 3 x 60cm, and 3 x 80cm) to support various loads, with corrosion-resistant steel J-hooks for fast, secure fixing, delivering controlled tension to limit movement in transit. Suitable for professional hauling, storage and everyday securing tasks where strength and reliability are required.
